lines.en: : So! Now that you guys have spent a good thirty minutes each on Sensei, do I get a turn as well? Or is this the part where we remember this is a group setting and that we should be together as a {i}group?{/i}
lines.zh: 那么！既然你们各自都在 Sensei 身上花了整整三十分钟，是不是也该轮到我了？还是说，这时候我们该想起来这是个集体场合，我们应该作为一个{i}集体{/i}待在一起？

lines.en: : Hey, don’t look at me. I had a {i}good{/i} reason. Maya was just impatient.
lines.zh: 嘿，别看我。我可是有{i}正当理由{/i}的。Maya 只是没耐心。

lines.en: : Yes. That is me, alright. An impatient person who’s entirely incapable of ever waiting for anything.
lines.zh: 对。我就是这种人，没错。一个完全没耐心、什么事都等不了的人。

lines.en: : Great! Then I guess that means we’re finally ready for some sort of activity we can all do together.
lines.zh: 太好了！那我猜我们终于可以搞点大家都能一起参与的活动了。

lines.en: : Under normal circumstances, I’d suggest karaoke on account of being {i}inside a karaoke booth.{/i} But it seems that no one cares about that tonight, so I guess we’ll have to figure something else out!
lines.zh: 正常情况下，我会建议唱卡拉 OK，毕竟我们{i}就在一个卡拉 OK 包厢里{/i}。但看来今晚没人在乎这个，那我们只好想点别的了！

lines.en: : I like when you get all passive aggressive. It doesn’t happen very often. But when it does, it’s fun.
lines.zh: 我喜欢你这种阴阳怪气的样子。不常见。不过一出现就很有趣。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad you find it amusing! Now, does anyone have any suggestions?
lines.zh: 嗯，你觉着有意思就好！那么，有人有什么建议吗？

lines.en: : We could play truth or dare? We’ve never done it with Sensei before.
lines.zh: 我们可以玩真心话大冒险？我们还没跟 Sensei 玩过呢。

lines.en: : That’s likely on account of what you’d all dare him to do.
lines.zh: 大概是因为你们会冒险让他去做什么吧。

lines.en: : Bold of you to assume he’d choose “dare” instead of truth.
lines.zh: 你真敢假设他会选「大冒险」而不是「真心话」。

lines.en: : Not when you remember he’s a novice at best when it comes to honesty and an incorrigible pervert with complete awareness that all of you would just dare him to kiss you.
lines.zh: 只要你想起来，他在诚实这件事上充其量是个新手，而且是个无可救药的变态——他完全清楚你们只会冒险让他亲你们。

lines.en: : Why stop there when you can dare him to kill everyone in the room and live with you happily ever after?
lines.zh: 既然可以直接冒险让他杀光屋里所有人、然后跟你幸福快乐地生活在一起，为什么要停在亲一下？

lines.en: : This. This is why we have not played truth or dare with Sensei.
lines.zh: 就是因为这个。这就是我们没跟 Sensei 玩过真心话大冒险的原因。

lines.en: : Yeah, and I’m starting to feel like we should keep things that way. There’s gotta be {i}something,{/i} though.
lines.zh: 是啊，我开始觉得我们应该继续保持下去。不过总得找点{i}什么{/i}吧。

lines.en: : Do {i}you{/i} have any ideas, Sana? You’ve been pretty quiet ever since I got back.
lines.zh: {i}你{/i}有什么主意吗，Sana？我从回来之后你就一直很安静。

lines.en: : Sana’s pretty quiet all the time. This shouldn’t come as a surprise to you, Ami.
lines.zh: Sana 一直都很安静。这不该让你意外啊，Ami。
我……嗯……我不太……认识什么游戏……

lines.en: : At least...not the kind you...play in person...
lines.zh: 至少……不是那种……当着面玩的……

lines.en: : Oh, come on! You’ve gotta know {i}something!{/i} Let that extrovert you keep locked inside the closet loose, my girl! We’re the closest friends you’ve got!
lines.zh: 哦，拜托！你总该知道{i}点什么{/i}吧！把你锁在柜子里的那个外向人格放出来吧，我的姑娘！我们可是你最亲近的朋友！
嗯……有……呃……国王游戏？……
那就脱衣扑克吧！

lines.en: : We don’t even have any cards.
lines.zh: 我们连牌都没有。

lines.en: : Is that really the issue here?
lines.zh: 这真的是问题所在吗？

lines.en: : I’m sure there’s a deck around here somewhere. We just have to look around.
lines.zh: 我肯定这附近哪儿有一副牌。我们找找就是了。
好吧，那就……不玩国王游戏……

lines.en: : With all due respect, Sana, I think we should avoid {i}any{/i} game that could potentially give Sensei control over everyone in the room.
lines.zh: 恕我直言，Sana，我觉得我们应该避开{i}任何{/i}可能让 Sensei 掌控屋里所有人的游戏。

lines.en: : Sensei can do anything he wants to me. I’m more worried about what Ami’s commands would be. Especially now that she’s already given her dare away.
lines.zh: Sensei 想对我做什么都行。我更担心 Ami 会下什么命令。尤其是她已经把她的「大冒险」给用掉了。
还有……那个转瓶子的？……

lines.en: : Ooh, good idea! Let’s play in groups! Sensei and I will spin our own bottle on the table and the rest of you can go play in the corner.
lines.zh: 哦，好主意！我们分组玩吧！Sensei 和我在桌上转我们自己的瓶子，你们几个去角落玩。

lines.en: : Aww, come on Ami! Don’t you want to kiss me again? We had so much fun the last time!
lines.zh: 哎呀，别这样嘛 Ami！你不想再亲我一次了吗？上次我们玩得多开心啊！
不如玩「我从来没有」？

lines.en: : Huh...I guess that could work. I think we’d need to set some ground rules, though. I feel like that game could go sour pretty quickly if someone says the wrong thing.
lines.zh: 嗯……我觉得这个可以。不过我觉得得先定几条基本规则。我觉得万一有人说错话，这游戏会很快就变味。

lines.en: : Like “Never have I ever seen my uncle’s penis?”
lines.zh: 比如「我从来没有见过我叔叔的鸡巴」？

lines.en: : Yes, Ami. Exactly like that. Good job.
lines.zh: 对，Ami。就是这种。说得好。
我玩……那个游戏……

lines.en: : May I propose that our primary rule be that no one says anything pertaining to Sensei at any point? I feel as if avoiding him entirely is the only safe option right now.
lines.zh: 我提议我们的首要规则是：任何人在任何时候都不许说与 Sensei 有关的任何事。我觉得现在彻底避开他是唯一安全的选择。

lines.en: : Why would you suggest a game he can’t even participate in?
lines.zh: 你为什么要提一个他根本没法参与的游戏？

lines.en: : Just look at him. I doubt he’ll be {i}participating{/i} in anything we do.
lines.zh: 你看看他那副样子。我怀疑我们做什么他都不会{i}参与{/i}。

lines.en: : Heheh! He’s probably still a little exhausted from our talk.
lines.zh: 嘿嘿！他大概还在为我们那次谈话而有点累。

lines.en: : Don’t we need, like...drinks to play that, though? All we have is soda and I’m not about to give myself diabetes for the sake of a game.
lines.zh: 不过我们不需要……那个什么……喝的才能玩吗？我们只有汽水，我可不想为了一个游戏把自己喝出糖尿病。

lines.en: : We can play for points instead. Whoever has done the least amount of stuff by the end of the game will be deemed the “Angel of purity.” I’ll have Geoffrey make a trophy. He has smithing skills, you know.
lines.zh: 我们可以改成计分。游戏结束时做过的事最少的人，将被封为「纯洁天使」。我会让 Geoffrey 做个奖杯。他有锻造手艺的，你知道吗。

lines.en: : So, should we have him start engraving Sana’s name on the trophy now? Or would you prefer to wait until he’s done cleaning up after a bunch of our classmates?
lines.zh: 那么，我们要现在就让他开始把 Sana 的名字刻上奖杯吗？还是你想等他先收拾完我们那群同学的烂摊子再说？

lines.en: : Hey! I’m a good girl. I’ve got a shot at winning too. Don’t count me out just yet, jerk.
lines.zh: 嘿！我是个好女孩。我也有机会赢的。别这么快就把我排除在外，混蛋。

lines.en: : Same here! I think we’ve all got a good shot! For all we know, Sana could be the biggest freak out of all of us.
lines.zh: 我也是！我觉得我们都有机会！说不定 Sana 才是我们当中最大的变态呢。

lines.en: : I guess there’s only one way to find out — so why don’t I start?
lines.zh: 我想只有一种办法能知道——不如我先来？

lines.en: : Never have I ever...stalked someone on social media. Raise your hand if you have.
lines.zh: 我从来没有……在社交媒体上跟踪过别人。做过的举手。

lines.en: : Tch. That was a cop-out question. You barely even use social media.
lines.zh: 啧。这问题也太敷衍了。你自己基本都不怎么用社交媒体。

lines.en: : I stalked Noriko when she joined the class. I was intimidated by her love for Sensei and thought it may outweigh mine. But now I firmly believe I love him more than anyone. Even Ami.
lines.zh: Noriko 转到我们班上的时候我跟踪过她。我被她对 Sensei 的爱吓到了，觉得那份爱可能盖过我的。但现在我坚信我比任何人都更爱他。连 Ami 都比不上。

lines.en: : Wait...so...I get a point if...my hand isn’t raised...right?
lines.zh: 等等……所以……如果……我不举手，就得一分……对吧？

lines.en: : The opposite. Think of the points as demerits. You want as few as possible, and the person with the least amount whenever we stop wins.
lines.zh: 相反。把分数想成扣分。你要的分数越少越好，等我们停下时分数最少的人赢。
听起来……有点乱……

lines.en: : It’s probably easier when there’s alcohol involved. We’ve never really done this before.
lines.zh: 有酒的时候大概会容易点。我们以前真没怎么玩过这个。

lines.en: : Never {i}have we ever{/i} done this before, you mean.
lines.zh: 你是说，我们从来{i}没有{/i}玩过这个吧。

lines.en: : Ooh, you should do “Never have I ever made a good joke” for your next one. That’s a sure-fire way for you to cut down the lead, Ami!
lines.zh: 哦，你下一题该出「我从来没有讲过一个好笑话」。这绝对能帮你把差距缩小，Ami！
我要杀了你。

lines.en: : So...Maya and I...both don’t have any points?...
lines.zh: 所以……Maya 和我……都是零分？……

lines.en: : I just want to make sure I’m...doing the right thing...
lines.zh: 我只是想确认一下我……做对了……

lines.en: : That is correct. Now, seeing as I went first, it’s someone else’s turn to-
lines.zh: 没错。那么，既然我先来，接下来轮到别人-

lines.en: : Never have I ever...been outside of Kumon-mi!
lines.zh: 我从来没有……离开过 Kumon-mi！

lines.en: : That is a personal attack. You know I’m not from here.
lines.zh: 这是人身攻击。你知道我不是这儿的人。

lines.en: : Darn it. I’ve got two points already?! I wanted to be the angel of purity!
lines.zh: 可恶。我已经两分了？！我还想当纯洁天使的！

lines.en: : Ayane? Really? You’ve left Kumon-mi before?
lines.zh: Ayane？真的假的？你以前离开过 Kumon-mi？

lines.en: : Mhm! I went sledding in Aomori with my dad when I was little. But it was before I ever met you, so you can’t get mad at me for not inviting you.
lines.zh: 嗯！我小时候跟我爸去青森滑雪橇。不过那是在我认识你之前，所以你不能怪我没叫你。

lines.en: : I’m not mad. I’m perfectly fine with never leaving this place.
lines.zh: 我没生气。我完全接受自己永远不离开这个地方。

lines.en: : Then boy do I have good news for you.
lines.zh: 那我可有个好消息要告诉你。

lines.en: : Even if we {i}could{/i} leave, I mean.
lines.zh: 我是说，就算我们{i}能{/i}离开。

lines.en: : I’m the same way. Aomori was fun and all, but I love it here. I’m never planning on leaving.
lines.zh: 我也是。青森挺好玩的，但我爱这里。我从来没打算离开。

lines.en: : Well {i}I{/i}, for one, would like to get out of here as soon as possible.
lines.zh: 至于{i}我{/i}，我是想尽快离开这儿的。

lines.en: : I’ve...never left either, but...I don’t really care either way...
lines.zh: 我也……从没离开过，不过……我无所谓……

lines.en: : Hey, why don’t {i}you{/i} go next? You’re the only one without any points so far. Why not try and extend the lead a little bit?
lines.zh: 嘿，{i}你{/i}为什么不下一个？你是目前唯一一个零分的。为什么不试着把领先优势拉大一点？
嗯……呃……好吧。

lines.en: : Then...um...never have I ever...k...kissed a boy...
lines.zh: 那么……嗯……我从来没有……亲……亲过男孩……

lines.en: : I’ll call Geoffrey in a few minutes and have him start on the trophy.
lines.zh: 我过几分钟就叫 Geoffrey 来，让他开始做奖杯。
Ayane 我……已经……呃……可是……连你也一样吗，Maya？……
这让你很意外吗？
我可一点都不意外。
嗯……是谁……是谁-

lines.en: : He goes to a different school. You don’t know him.
lines.zh: 他在别的学校上学。你不认识他。

lines.en: : So, since Sana’s already going to win, why don’t the three of us start taking bites out of each other? I think a little infighting between the original members of the Love Squad sounds kind of fun.
lines.zh: 那么，既然 Sana 已经赢定了，我们三个不如开始互相撕咬？我觉得恋爱小队原始成员之间来点内讧听起来还挺有意思的。

lines.en: : So long as you promise to not get weird about it.
lines.zh: 只要你保证别搞得很奇怪。

lines.en: : I think I can do that.
lines.zh: 我觉得我能做到。

lines.en: : I can’t! Never have I ever touched myself in school.
lines.zh: 我可做不到！我从来没有在学校里自慰过。

lines.en: : What? Your girl needs some points.
lines.zh: 怎么了？你家姑娘需要点分数。

lines.en: : In my defense, puberty is very hard on my body sometimes and I was simply doing what needed to be done.
lines.zh: 我得为自己辩解一下，青春期有时候对我身体来说很难熬，我只是做了该做的事。

lines.en: : I don’t have anything to say in my defense. I was just having a weird day.
lines.zh: 我没什么可为自己辩解的。我只是那天有点奇怪。

lines.en: : And so the lead begins to shrink...
lines.zh: 于是差距开始缩小了……
不过 Sana 除外。她-
Sana？！？！

lines.en: : It’s...umm...I think it’s like...what Ami said...
lines.zh: 那个……嗯……我觉得就像……Ami 说的那样……

lines.en: : Well now {i}I{/i} feel weird for {i}not{/i} doing it! Could you guys seriously not wait until you got home? Doing that in school is-
lines.zh: 那{i}我{/i}倒因为{i}没{/i}做过而觉得怪了！你们就不能等回家再做吗？在学校里做那种事是-
哦……等等。不。

lines.en: : I think I did do it once, actually.
lines.zh: 我想我其实做过一次。
大概吧？
我有吗？

lines.en: : I honestly can’t remember. Can I still just...not get this point, though? I’m starting to feel impure.
lines.zh: 我真的记不清了。不过我能不能就……不拿这一分？我开始觉得自己不纯洁了。

lines.en: : I’d like to hear what your argument {i}against{/i} impurity would be, seeing as you just asked a room full of teenage girls about public masturbation in front of an adult male.
lines.zh: 我倒是想听听你{i}反驳{/i}「不纯洁」的理由，毕竟你刚刚在一屋子青春期女孩面前、还当着一个成年男性的面问起了公开自慰。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Sensei’s here. He’s been so quiet that I kind of forgot.
lines.zh: 哦，对。Sensei 还在呢。他一直这么安静，我都有点忘了。

lines.en: : He also hasn’t raised his hand for anything so, in a roundabout way, I think he’s technically winning now that we know Sana plays with herself in school.
lines.zh: 而且他什么都没举过手，所以绕个弯来说，既然我们知道 Sana 在学校里会自己玩自己，他现在技术上算是领先了。
没错……
还有别的所有地方。
呃呃呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Umm...Sana? You don’t have to really...{i}share{/i} those details with us, you know. The question was just about {i}school.{/i} You can leave it at that.
lines.zh: 嗯……Sana？你其实不用真的……跟我们{i}分享{/i}那些细节，你知道的。问题只是关于{i}学校{/i}的。说到这儿就行了。

lines.en: : I did it in the park last week. I think somebody saw me.
lines.zh: 上周我在公园里做了。我觉得有人看见我了。
Sana！

lines.en: : I do it on the train...the bus...I even did it at your party...
lines.zh: 我在电车上做……公交车上……我甚至在你家派对上做过……
Ayane……
什么？你们为什么-

lines.en: : Wait...no. No no no no no.
lines.zh: 等等……不。不不不不不。

lines.en: : Now?...It’s not seriously happening {i}now,{/i} is it?!
lines.zh: 现在？……总不会是{i}现在{/i}正在发生吧？！

lines.en: : What’s happening now? What are you guys talking about?
lines.zh: 现在在发生什么？你们在说什么啊？

lines.en: : I want to do it in here...
lines.zh: 我想在这儿做……

lines.en: : {b}I want to do it right now...{/b}
lines.zh: {b}我现在就想做……{/b}

lines.en: : I can feel it again...swimming through me...I need to let it out. I need to {b}66 65 65 6c 20 74 68 65 20 6c 69 67 68 74.{/b}
lines.zh: : 我又感觉到了……它在我体内游动……我得把它放出来。我需要{b}66 65 65 6c 20 74 68 65 20 6c 69 67 68 74.(感受光吧。){/b}
哈……哈……不好了……不好了……又来了……

lines.en: : What do we do?! What’s going on with her?!
lines.zh: 我们该怎么办？！她怎么了？！

lines.en: : What’s going on with who? Seriously, what are you guys freaking out about?
lines.zh: 谁怎么了？说真的，你们在慌什么？

lines.en: : Sana, obviously! {i}Sana!{/i} You should know by now she isn’t like this! This isn’t her!
lines.zh: 当然是 Sana！{i}Sana！{/i} 你现在该知道她不是这样的！这不是她！

lines.en: : Sana...Sakakibara? From Ms. Watabe’s class? Are you guys friends or something?
lines.zh: Sana……Sakakibara？渡部老师班上的那个？你们是朋友什么的吗？

lines.en: : Ms. Watabe’s class?! She’s right here! She’s our friend! She’s-
lines.zh: 渡部老师的班？！她就在这儿啊！她是我们的朋友！她是-

lines.en: : No. No, no, no. Bad Ayane. You’re supposed to keep calm. This is normal. This is how these things work now. Things are going to be weird and you just have to deal with it. That’s your life. Your {i}new{/i} life.
lines.zh: 不。不，不，不。坏 Ayane。你该保持冷静。这很正常。现在这些事就是这么运作的。事情会变得很奇怪，你只能去面对。这就是你的生活。你的{i}新{/i}生活。
你可以之后再哭。
它就这么来了，我一点都不知道……
这一点也不正常……

lines.en: : It’s going to be okay. Everything is going to be okay.
lines.zh: 会没事的。一切都会没事的。

lines.en: : Ayane, you’re seriously starting to scare me. If something is going on, please tell me about it. I want to be there for you.
lines.zh: Ayane，你真的开始吓到我了。如果有事发生，请你告诉我。我想陪在你身边。
Sensei……
你是-

lines.en: : Would it be...okay if I...sang a song?
lines.zh: 我……可以唱首歌吗？
当然可以，Sana！尽管唱！
你？真的？

lines.en: : My little girl is all grown up!
lines.zh: 我家小姑娘长大了！
我……唱得不太好，但是……

lines.en: : I just figured that...I should try and...put myself out there...a little more...
lines.zh: 我只是觉得……我应该试着……把自己多放开一点……
尤其是如果……
如果我终将要……

lines.en: : {b}THE WORLD IS ENDING AND WE ARE ALL GOING TO DIE!{/b}
lines.zh: {b}世界要完蛋了，我们全都会死！{/b}

lines.en: : Wow...I had no idea Sana had such a fantastic singing voice. I wonder why she’s been keeping it a secret for so long?
lines.zh: 哇……我不知道 Sana 的歌声这么棒。她为什么瞒了这么久？

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m surprised as well. This is one of my favorite songs.
lines.zh: 是啊，我也很意外。这是我最喜欢的歌之一。

lines.en: : How do you feel about it, Ami? You used to love this song, didn't you?
lines.zh: 你觉得呢，Ami？你以前很喜欢这首歌的，不是吗？
Ami？你-
她……不见了？

lines.en: : I didn’t even see her get up. Did she go to the bathroom or something?
lines.zh: 我都没看见她站起来。她是去洗手间还是怎么了？

lines.en: : I don’t know...I didn’t see her get up either.
lines.zh: 我不知道……我也没看见她站起来。

lines.en: : She went out into the hallway.
lines.zh: 她走到走廊上去了。

lines.en: : Oh, nice of you to join us. And why? For what? She wasn’t trying to get you to come with her again, was she?
lines.zh: 哦，你总算肯加入我们了。为什么？为了什么？她不是又想拉你跟她走吧？

lines.en: : She said someone was calling her name.
lines.zh: 她说有人在叫她的名字。

lines.en: : Who? We’re all in here. There’s no one who-
lines.zh: 谁？我们都在这儿。没有谁会-
Maya……

lines.en: : What? I’m trying to figure out-
lines.zh: 什么？我正想搞清-
走廊里有东西……
你说的有东西是什-
有东西……在……
那是……

lines.en: : That’s not what I think it is...is it?
lines.zh: 那不是我想的那个东西吧……是吗？
我不知……

lines.en: : It’s calling to me now too.
lines.zh: 现在它也在叫我了。

lines.en: : You’re not going anywhere. Stay put.
lines.zh: 你哪儿也不许去。待着别动。
什么？！那{i}你{/i}要去？！认真的？！

lines.en: : You’re more than welcome to stay here with Sensei while I check on Ami.
lines.zh: 你完全可以留在这里陪 Sensei，我去看看 Ami。

lines.en: : Absolutely not! I can’t let you go out there alone!
lines.zh: 绝对不行！我不能让你一个人出去！

lines.en: : Maya, that’s blood. That’s definitely blood. I don’t like this.
lines.zh: Maya，那是血。那绝对是血。我不喜欢这样。
她{i}确实{/i}到那个年纪了。
Sensei，坐下。{i}现在。{/i}

lines.en: : Oh my God. What do we do? Is this a reset? It is, right? It’s just part of the...the thing, right?!
lines.zh: 哦天哪。我们该怎么办？这是重置吗？是的吧？这只是……那件事的一部分，对吧？！

lines.en: : If it is, I can’t feel it. And I have no idea if that’s a good or a bad thing. It’s never happened before.
lines.zh: 如果是的话，我感觉不到。而且我不知道那是好事还是坏事。以前从没发生过。

lines.en: : If you guys find Ami, can you ask her what’s for dinner tonight? I’m starting to feel a little peckish.
lines.zh: 如果你们找到 Ami，能帮我问问她今晚晚饭吃什么吗？我开始有点饿了。

lines.en: : Sure, Sensei. We’ll do just that.
lines.zh: 好的，Sensei。我们会替你问的。

lines.en: : Oh my God. We’re going out there? Shouldn’t we just call the cops instead? Wouldn’t that be the right thing to do if that’s really-
lines.zh: 哦天哪。我们真要出去吗？不该直接报警吗？如果那真的是——报警才是正确的做法吧？

lines.en: : Stay here if you’re just going to cry. I’ll go alone.
lines.zh: 你要是只想哭，就留在这儿。我一个人去。

lines.en: : {i}I’m coming, okay?! Stop thinking you can do everything alone!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我会去的，好吗？！别以为你什么都能一个人扛下来！{/i}

lines.en: : Welp! Looks like it’s just you and me now, Sana.
lines.zh: 哎呀！看来现在只剩你和我了，Sana。
Sensei……
想插进来吗？

lines.en: : No no no no no no no...
lines.zh: 不不不不不不不……

lines.en: : No no no no no No No No No No NO NO NO NO {b}NO NO NO NO NO NO!{/B}
lines.zh: 不不不不不不不不不不不不不不{b}不不不不不不不！{/B}
: {b}{size=+20}AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!{/size}{/b}
: {b}{size=+10}AAAAHHH!!! AAAAAAHHHH!!! AAAAAAHHHHHH!!! AAAAaaaaaaAAAAAAAAAaaaahhhh!!!!! AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!{/size}{/b}

lines.en: : {b}{size=+10}I DON’T WANT TO DO THIS ANYMORE, MAYA!!!! I CAN’T DO THIS ANYMORE! I WANT MY OLD LIFE BACK!!!!{/size}{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}{size=+10}我不想再做这种事了，MAYA！！！！我做不下去了！我想要回我过去的生活！！！！{/size}{/b}

lines.en: : I think it might be a little too late for that.
lines.zh: 我觉得现在说这个可能有点太晚了。
: Mmh! Mmh! Mmh!

lines.en: : I can’t do this. I can’t do this. I can’t do this. I can’t do this!
lines.zh: 我做不到。我做不到。我做不到。我做不到！

lines.en: : {b}I CAN’T DO THIS I CAN’T DO THIS I CAN’T DO THIS I CAN’T DO THIS I CAN’T DO THIS  I CAN’T DO THIS  I CAN’T DO THIS  I CAN’T DO THIS  I CAN’T DO THIS  I CAN’T DO THIS I-{/b}
lines.zh: {b}我做不到 我做不到 我做不到 我做不到 我做不到 我做不到 我做不到 我做不到 我做不到 我做不到 我做不到我-{/b}
: {b}BLLFCHTTHHTHHTHTFRWRBWBRBR!!!!!1111!!!1111!!!!111!!!{/b}
我想回家……

lines.en: : Get it all out of your system?
lines.zh: 都吐干净了？

lines.en: : {b}Our friend is dead! Look at her! Shouldn’t you have a little more to say?!{/b}
lines.zh: {b}我们的朋友死了！你看看她！你就不该多说点什么吗？！{/b}

lines.en: : Do you think it would be more productive for me to hack {i}my{/i} dinner out onto the floor as well?
lines.zh: 你觉得我也把{i}我的{/i}晚饭吐一地会更有建设性吗？

lines.en: : Someone here needs to keep a level head and that someone is obviously going to be me as you’re too busy coughing up...whatever that is.
lines.zh: 这儿得有人保持冷静，而那个人显然是我，因为你正忙着咳出……管它是什么玩意儿。

lines.en: : Do you have a heart at all?! How can you see this and feel nothing?! Are you even human?!
lines.zh: 你到底有没有心？！看到这个你怎么能毫无感觉？！你到底是不是人？！

lines.en: : Who would do this?...Why?...How?...And how didn’t we notice?...
lines.zh: 谁会做这种事？……为什么？……怎么做到的？……还有我们怎么一点都没发现？……

lines.en: : The “who” and “how” don’t matter. What {i}does{/i} matter is making sure we’re on the same page.
lines.zh: 「谁」和「怎么做」都不重要。{i}真正{/i}重要的是确保我们想法一致。
Ami……{i}Ami……{/i}
Ayane，看着我！

lines.en: : You and I are the only two people who still have our minds intact right now. And if you don’t get your shit together {i}immediately,{/i} Sensei and I could be stuck on that roof for weeks waiting for you.
lines.zh: 现在这里只有你和我两个人的神智还算清醒。如果你不{i}立刻{/i}振作起来，Sensei 和我可能会被困在那个天台上好几个星期等你。

lines.en: : He very likely isn’t going to snap out of his {i}delusions{/i} until he makes it up there. And {i}I’m{/i} another story entirely.
lines.zh: 在他爬上去之前，他很可能不会从他的{i}妄想{/i}里清醒过来。而{i}我{/i}又是另一回事了。

lines.en: : She’s gonna come back, right? After this is all over?
lines.zh: 她会回来的，对吧？等这一切结束之后？
会。
我相信{i}她{/i}会回来的。

lines.en: : Now, clean yourself up. You look disgusting.
lines.zh: 现在，把自己收拾干净。你看着真恶心。

lines.en: : You’re a real fucking asshole sometimes, Maya. You know that, right?
lines.zh: 你有时候真是个彻头彻尾的混蛋，Maya。你知道的，对吧？
我很清楚，Ayane。
谢谢。

lines.en: : Hey. I know you’re probably only 5%% sentient right now, but I’ve got some bad news. Ami won’t be making dinner tonight. And also, the world is ending. Surprise.
lines.zh: 嘿。我知道你现在大概只有 5%% 的清醒度，但我有个坏消息。Ami 今晚不会做晚饭了。还有，世界要完蛋了。惊不惊喜。

lines.en: : Now, we need to get you back home so you’re not mindlessly wandering around and-
lines.zh: 现在，我们得把你送回家，免得你在这儿漫无目的地乱晃，然后-
哇哦。
: MMFGH! MMFHG! MMMNNGHHH! MMMNGHHH!!!!!!

lines.en: : Never have I ever done {i}that{/i} before.
lines.zh: 我从来没有做过{i}那种事{/i}。
嗨，Maya。

lines.en: : Stop smiling. It’s somehow even weirder than...whatever the hell is happening on that table right now.
lines.zh: 别笑。这不知怎么比……桌上现在发生的那堆破事还要诡异。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I’m just really happy to be out having fun with you. That’s all.
lines.zh: 抱歉。我只是真的很开心能跟你出来玩。就这样。

lines.en: : Right. Well, you can be happy in your bed. We’re leaving.
lines.zh: 行吧。那你可以回床上开心去。我们走了。

lines.en: : But Sana hasn’t finished her song yet.
lines.zh: 可 Sana 还没唱完她的歌呢。
: MMMMNNGHHHHHHH!

lines.en: : Yeah, I really don’t care about that.
lines.zh: 是啊，我才不管那个。

lines.en: : Come on. I’m tired of having to chase after you when-
lines.zh: 走吧。我受够了每次都要追着你跑，就-
Maya？
